records.text:
Select the most appropriate option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word: proportionate.
The Constitution of India ensures proportionate representation from all regions.
records.note: Reasoned answer A, not an official-key claim. The dictionary publisher defines proportionate as properly balanced/in due proportion: balanced is the only matching synonym. Partial is incomplete or biased, unlikely concerns probability, suffragette is a person, not this adjective. Second pass confirmed the underlined word and all four printed choices.

primaryEvidence.locator: Publisher's definition and usage: properly balanced

records.text: The manner in which the demolitions have been carried out _____ scrutiny by the High Court.
records.note: Original blank and choices restored. C is the likely intended present-tense answer, but A also forms a grammatical past-tense main clause; the supplied sentence provides no decisive time reference. B and D lack a finite main verb. No matching official key recovered. Quarantine rather than force a single accepted answer; clearing requires the official A-series Q49 key or an authoritative exam-specific clarification.

primaryEvidence.locator: be/is, present situations; tense choice does not eliminate a past main clause

records.text: The Constitution (Seventy-third Amendment) Act provides for

options.A: an elaborate system of establishing municipal self-government
options.B: an elaborate system of establishing panchayats as units of self-government
options.C: establishing a Commission for Linguistic Minorities
options.D: the creation of the Jharkhand State

records.note: Reasoned B: the enacted 73rd Amendment inserts Part IX, The Panchayats, including their constitution and self-government powers. Municipalities are Part IXA/74th Amendment; linguistic minorities and Jharkhand are not objects of this Act. Second pass checked the enacted text against all four printed options.

records.text:
Match List I with List II and select the answer using the code given below the Lists:
List I (Five Year Plan)
A. Fifth Five Year Plan
B. Seventh Five Year Plan
C. Ninth Five Year Plan
D. Eleventh Five Year Plan
List II (Objective)
1. Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth
2. Garibi Hatao (Removal of Poverty)
3. Food, Work and Productivity
4. Growth with Social Justice and Equality
Code: A B C D
records.note: Reasoned B: the government planning account assigns food/work/productivity to the Seventh Plan (B-3); the Eleventh Plan's own foreword specifies faster and more inclusive growth (D-1). Only displayed B satisfies both independently established matches; A and C fail B-3, D fails D-1. Remaining Fifth-2 and Ninth-4 align with the printed historical objectives. Second pass reconstructed both complete lists and all four codes from original page 15.

primaryEvidence.locator: Basic issues guiding Seventh Plan, Planning Commission member's stated objectives
Prime Minister's foreword: faster and more inclusive growth

records.note: Reasoned A: consent of the governed and political equality describe democratic rule. Statement 3 reverses the democratic accountability relationship: government/rulers answer to citizens, not ruled to ruler. Therefore combinations containing 3 (B/C/D) fail. Second pass compared the exact direction of accountability and each combination.

primaryEvidence.locator: Outcomes of Democracy: accountable government and political equality
